model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the overall performance (in percentage) of various large language models (LLMs) on a knowledge-grounded discussion summarization benchmark, specifically under the EBS-AOS evaluation pattern, where the reported values represent the performance of 0.90% of all tested LLMs. The vertical axis denotes “Overall Performance (%)” ranging from 0 to 80, with major gridlines at intervals of 20. Ten distinct models are compared, each represented by a uniquely colored bar, with their exact performance values labeled above each bar: 76.24%, 73.94%, 34.24%, 72.09%, 77.12%, 46.02%, 76.71%, 67.58%, 63.63%, 66.50%, 64.34%, and 67.55%. The models are grouped into three performance tiers based on their Overall Performance under the geometric mean (OP_GM): Tier-1 includes models scoring between 72% and 77% (e.g., 76.24%, 73.94%, 72.09%, 77.12%, 76.71%), Tier-2 includes those between 64% and 68% (e.g., 67.58%, 63.63%, 66.50%, 64.34%, 67.55%), and Tier-3 includes the lowest performers between 34% and 46% (34.24% and 46.02%). The bars are arranged in descending order of performance, with Tier-1 models dominating the top, followed by Tier-2, and Tier-3 models at the bottom, visually emphasizing the stratification of model capabilities in this specific summarization task.
